title: Exterior derivative of a form that agrees with a smooth pull-back on an open set: d(G^#ω) = G^#(dω) locally
statement: Let P, Q, j ∈ ℕ, let G : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q be C^∞, ω : ℝ^Q → Λ^j(ℝ^Q) a C^∞ j-form (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) j with ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ω), θ : ℝ^P → Λ^j(ℝ^P) any j-form, and N ⊆ ℝ^P an open set with θ(x) = ω(G(x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G x) for every x ∈ N. Then for every x ∈ N, (dθ)(x) = (dω)(G(x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G x), where d = exteriorDerivative (SimonGMT's abbreviation of Mathlib's extDeriv).
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q j : ℕ) (G : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) j) (θ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) j) (N : Set (Eucl P)), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) G → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ω → IsOpen N → (∀ x ∈ N, θ x = (ω (G x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G x)) → ∀ x ∈ N, exteriorDerivative θ x = ((exteriorDerivative ω) (G x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G x)
